tweets.text_resolved: The application process is now open for Venezuelans to safely & lawfully travel to the U.S. Individuals who enter the U.S. without authorization, will be returned to Mexico. Learn more: https://www.uscis.gov/venezuela https://t.co/Y1p1AAU52A

media.alt_text:
Migration Process for Venezuelans: 
Do not attempt to cross U.S. border.
Do not cross into Panama or Mexico.
Do not believe smugglers.
Do have U.S.-based supporter file Form I-134.
Do wait for authorization from DHS before traveling to the U.S.
